tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mgon zhal bram nag shan pa drug bskor gyi bdag mdun rnam gzhag nyung ngu shan pa rab dga' bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ba la ha ren+d+ra bi pra s+ya rū pā ya/ 'dir rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa gnyan lugs su grags pa 'di la bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam gzhag las bram gzugs la mngon rtogs yod pa zhig cher ma mthong zhing bla ma gong ma rnams la zhal gzigs bram gzugs kha re yong 'dug kyang / de'i sgrub thabs gsungs pa'ang phal cher la med 'dra/ dzo ki kā ma rū pa sogs nas brgyud grub dbang thang stong rgyal por bka' babs pa'i bram nag shan pa drug bskor 'di bram gzugs kyi mngon rtogs yin 'dug pas de bzhin nyams len du brjod na/ 'di'i bsnyen pa thon pa'i gang zag gis bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis bsgom bzlas bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur du 'grub par shog /tshar gsum sogs kyis skyabs sems byas la/ oṃ shu n+yā tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang sems hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje nag po chen po stobs 'phrog dbang po bram ze'i gzugs can sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ sma ra dang smin ma brdzes shing ral cog dkar po spyi bor bcing zhing / phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gru mo na/ rtse gsum/ mdung thung / gri gug thod phreng 'phyang zhing bum pa mchan khung du thogs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dang stag sham can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ 'khor las byed gshan pa drug gis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ti se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po tā la/ ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod sogs nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ nag po'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ las bzhi'i nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim pas phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med du 'grub pa'i nus pa can du gyur/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci nus bzlas mthar rdo rje nag po chen po bram ze'i gzugs can gyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'khor rnams rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nag po chen po 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs spyi 'gre/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdul dka' 'dul phyir dpa' bo yi/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang / /mthun par 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces sam/ yang bdag mdun gtor bsngo byed na/ 'di'i sku'i drung sha chang bdud rtsi ril bu zan bcas las grub pa'i gtor ma gru gsum mam/ yang na gsar ma phal cher zlum gtor mdzad pas 'dab drug pa'am/ bzhi pa gang rung / gru gsum ltar na smug rtsi'am khrag gis byugs/ zlum gtor rtse med yin/ gang byed kyang mar dang shas brgyan/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug bdag bskyed gong bzhin/ bzlas pa'i mtha'i 'dod gsol grub nas gtor mar lag g.yon bstan la/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par sbyangs/ g.yas bstan la āḥzhes brjod pas thod snod/

gnyis ka bstan nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi gung mtheb so sor sbyar la gshibs/ de'i rgyab tu srin lag gnyis bsnol ba mdzub mo so sos bzung / de'i rgyab tu mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs nas bsgrengs ba bya khyung phyag rgya zhes pa lugs bzhed/ gdan bzhi'i rgyud tshig ltar rang mi gnang bas de bzhin bcas la/ ha ho hrīḥzhes brjod pas ye shes lnga'i ngo bo kha dog dri ro nus ldan du bsams la/ sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag ces sogs nas/ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po zhes sogs nas thim bar bdag mdun gyi tshig phran bu ma gtogs gong bzhin/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sha trun bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum sogs kyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+de/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes phyi mchod so so'i phyag rgya dang / nang mchod mtheb srin gyis 'bul ba'i stangs ka byas la/ hūm̐ dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing / /mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrog dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gzhon nu'i lus can bgegs 'joms 'khor bcas bstod/ /mdor na gang dang gang bcol ba/ /de dang de yi las rnams la/ /btang snyoms g.yel ba ma mdzad par/ /bdag la rjes su brtse bar mdzod/ /ces gtor ma phud chang bcas phyir phul nas dmigs rten bskyed pa yin na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes 'bru gtor/ ma bskyed na/ mdun bskyed 'khor bcas rang la thim/

rang gis dpral bar oṃ sogs gong bzhin no/ /zhes gong sa rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs 'gyur ba sku bcar mkhan po blo bzang dge 'dun zhes yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po nas 'di ltar gyis shig pa'i phyag bris rten bcas gnang don bzhin sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar ba 'di'i dge bas bzhed don kun bstan 'gror dge ba'i rang bzhin lhun grub tu 'byung bar gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal mgon zhal bram nag shan pa drug skor gyi bdag mdun rnam gzhag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
